rationale: This change records the owner-approved AgentScope-Embabel integration plan, its exact donor-planning assessment and the bounded approval needed for later donor registration. It does not add or modify a runner, provider, model, host service, hardware behavior, resource-placement path, executable runtime, Current Host proof recipe or promotion path. Application implementation remains blocked until the processed donor set is separately published and all subsequent admission gates pass. Therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification is required for this governance-only approval materialization.
